evidence.detail: The nested class extends MouseAdapter and is installed as both MouseListener and MouseMotionListener on DragAndDropReorderPane.
mousePressed records the left-button origin when more than one child exists; mouseDragged waits for DragSource.getDragThreshold(), begins or updates reordering, and mouseReleased finalizes the drag.
Every action delegates exclusively into DragAndDropReorderPane private drag/reorder methods and touches no unrelated client state.

proposals.note: DragAndDropReorderMouseHandler is a descriptive helper name for the pane's exclusive MouseAdapter drag controller. No original nested-class identifier is claimed. Confidence is 0.998.

evidence.detail: The enclosing pane's exact exception names its only supported layout as DragAndDropReorderLayoutManager.
The nested class extends BoxLayout with Y_AXIS, making the component stack vertical.
During layout it temporarily restores the dragged child to DEFAULT_LAYER, performs BoxLayout layout, then puts that child back into DRAG_LAYER and restores its free-drag screen location.

proposals.note: DragAndDropReorderLayoutManager is fixed by the exact surviving layout name plus its BoxLayout/Y_AXIS implementation. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: setLayout throws the exact literal 'DragAndDropReorderPane only supports DragAndDropReorderLayoutManager', directly preserving the pane role noun in v308.

The class extends JLayeredPane, installs its dedicated vertical reorder layout and one shared mouse listener/motion listener, and promotes the actively dragged child into DRAG_LAYER before restoring it to DEFAULT_LAYER.

Drag motion tracks the grabbed child, compares it against sibling midpoints, updates the target component position, revalidates layout, and on release notifies registered reorder listeners with the moved Component.

Exact class-reference scanning finds no project class outside rs/ui/components/g and its nested helpers referencing this family, so the proposal is deliberately limited to a reusable Swing component rather than a higher-level screen.

proposals.note: DragAndDropReorderPane follows an exact surviving v308 component name and complete reorder behavior. It is a reusable Swing primitive; no higher-level product feature ownership is claimed. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The nested public interface is a single-method functional interface whose only argument is the reordered java.awt.Component.
DragAndDropReorderPane exposes add/remove methods for a List of this interface.
When a drag completes, the pane iterates every registered listener and invokes the interface with the moved Component.

proposals.note: DragAndDropReorderListener is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the pane's one-method reorder callback interface. Confidence is 0.998.
